classification.source_level_rationale: The record is a verbatim transcript of a parliamentary session, created at the time of the events by the National Council.
classification.resume: This is a digital parliamentary record of an interpellation by Balthasar Glättli concerning the fair taxation of internet giants, recorded during the National Council session in the spring of 2018. The document contains the original title in German and French, indicating a bilingual legislative instrument. It is part of the National Council's debate protocols archived at the Swiss Federal Archives.
